title: Πρόληψη και ανθεκτικότητα
description: Ten standalone stories, interviews and columns about preparing for trouble and coming through it: earthquake-proofing, storms, health checks, online safety, community kitchens, water-wise gardens and the slow life of Ikaria.

lessons.title: Ένα σπίτι του εικοστού αιώνα
lessons.summary: A man in Patras has his grandfather's 1962 house checked after a mild earthquake, and an experienced builder strengthens its columns.

lessons.title: Τα μάτια δεν κάνουν διακοπές
lessons.summary: An eye doctor on Rhodes explains in an interview how to protect the eyes in summer: sunglasses, fresh mascara, quick care for warning signs and better sleep.

lessons.title: Η κουτάλα της κυρίας Ευανθίας
lessons.summary: A 72-year-old woman cooks every winter day at a parish soup kitchen in Thessaloniki, and the local bishop comes to serve beside her.

lessons.title: Η νύχτα του λυχναριού
lessons.summary: On Kalymnos a fisherman and his daughter prepare the harbour for a forecast storm with the help of soldiers, and the storm does little harm.

lessons.title: Μαθήματα ασφάλειας στη βιβλιοθήκη
lessons.summary: A librarian in Volos invites a retired counter-intelligence officer to teach older readers how to protect their phones and their privacy.

lessons.title: Το παλιό βιβλιάριο υγείας
lessons.summary: A 56-year-old man finally sees a doctor, learns he has early diabetes and follows a three-month programme that brings his health back.

lessons.title: Το μικρό μαμούθ της Κρήτης
lessons.summary: A biologist shows a school class the bones of a dwarf mammoth, a hyena skull and a kangaroo, and explains how species adapt and survive.

lessons.title: Στην Ικαρία δεν βιάζεται κανείς
lessons.summary: A journalist attends the unveiling of a plaque for the island's post-war exiles on Ikaria and reflects on the slow life behind its famous longevity.

lessons.title: Μια ώρα στο μποτιλιάρισμα
lessons.summary: A columnist sits for over an hour in an Athens traffic jam on a transport strike day and thinks about cars, tempers and good public transport.

lessons.title: Ο κήπος πίσω από το ανθοπωλείο
lessons.summary: A florist in Nafplio saves water with drought-hardy plants and turns her shop's waste into compost, and wins over a doubtful neighbour.
